relationships.subject: serum VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results indicate that VEGF may be associated with the PPTs of several tender points in women with FM

relationships.subject: serum CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: We found no association between serum CGRP levels and the variables measured (p ≥ 0.152).

key_findings: In women with fibromyalgia, serum VEGF was positively associated with pressure pain thresholds at trapezius, second metacarpal and tibialis anterior.
Serum CGRP was not associated with any pain or clinical variables.
